description: Guided opt-out fer TruePeopleSearch. A sailor follows the steps on the checklist; OpenOptOut hands over a one-time email address an' clicks any confirmation link.
instructions: Open truepeoplesearch.com/removal. Enter {full_name}, yer city an' state ({city}, {state}) an' {contact_email} as the email address, then solve the CAPTCHAs. If yer record be listed, smash the button to remove it. OpenOptOut clicks any confirmation link sent to that address. Then smash "I've done this".
